sn56.39:1.1: ye hi keci bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti …pe…
sn56.39:1.2: ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti te aññassa samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā mukhaṃ olokenti
sn56.39:1.3: ayaṃ nūna bhavaṃ jānaṃ jānāti passaṃ passatīti.
sn56.39:2.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave tūlapicu vā kappāsapicu vā lahuko vātupādāno same bhūmibhāge nikkhitto
sn56.39:2.2: tamenaṃ puratthimo vāto pacchimena saṃhareyya pacchimo vāto puratthimena saṃhareyya uttaro vāto dakkhiṇena saṃhareyya dakkhiṇo vāto uttarena saṃhareyya.
sn56.39:2.5: evameva kho bhikkhave ye hi keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti …pe…
sn56.39:2.6: ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti te aññassa samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā mukhaṃ olokenti
sn56.39:2.7: ayaṃ nūna bhavaṃ jānaṃ jānāti passaṃ passatīti.
sn56.39:3.1: ye ca kho keci bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānanti …pe…
sn56.39:3.2: ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānanti te na aññassa samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā mukhaṃ olokenti
sn56.39:3.3: ayaṃ nūna bhavaṃ jānaṃ jānāti passaṃ passatīti.
sn56.39:4.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave ayokhīlo vā indakhīlo vā gambhīranemo sunikhāto acalo asampakampi
sn56.39:4.2: puratthimāya cepi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi neva saṅkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampacāleyya pacchimāya cepi disāya …pe… uttarāya cepi disāya. dakkhiṇāya cepi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi neva saṅkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampacāleyya.
sn56.39:4.5: evameva kho bhikkhave ye keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānanti …pe…
sn56.39:4.6: ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānanti te na aññassa samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā mukhaṃ olokenti
sn56.39:4.7: ayaṃ nūna bhavaṃ jānaṃ jānāti passaṃ passatīti.
sn56.39:5.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhave idaṃ dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yogo karaṇīyoti.
